data.text: I commit to 15 tons today and will donate the full $15,000 to the clinic, provided John and Jack also commit so our donations meet the full payment requirement. I’ll keep my catch to six tons next month under the combined 30-ton recovery cap. Helping the clinic matters, and so does keeping our lake healthy for the families who depend on it. Let’s record everyone’s catches and confirm the payment together today. John, are you in for both the donation and the recovery plan?
